property_summary: For any inputs, transfer always returns true and never reverts, regardless of the target addresses.
For any nonempty array of target addresses and any other inputs, transfer makes exactly one low-level call per target address and always returns true.
For any single target address with no value and any inputs, transfer returns true without reverting.
For any nonempty array of target addresses and any inputs, transfer returns true without reverting.
For any single non-zero target address, transfer always returns true and does not revert.
For any nonempty list of recipients, C.transfer always returns true and never reverts, even when the low-level calls it makes to the given contract address fail.
For any single recipient with a nonempty call to a contract that produces no return data, C.transfer always returns true and does not revert.
For any nonempty recipient list, C.transfer returns true and does not revert.
For any single-recipient list and any target address, C.transfer always returns true and never reverts, regardless of whether the low-level call succeeds.
For any call to C.transfer with a nonempty recipient list, the contract always returns true and does not revert.
